business_problem: ATV Big Air Tour needed a way to handle show logistics, marketing, communications, and on-site problem solving with a very small team because administrative work was consuming time the founders needed for growth and family life.
solution_summary: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT as a general-purpose operations assistant across back-office planning and live event execution. Derek and Larissa Guetter rely on the model to create marketing plans, social strategies, client reports, tour schedules, and equipment inventories before shows, then carry the same assistant into event days for speaker setup, MC script drafting, giveaway tracking, rider scheduling, mechanical troubleshooting, and sponsor evaluation. The workflow is intentionally lightweight: operational questions, logistics details, or business documents are entered into ChatGPT or voice mode, and the responses become immediate working plans the founders can apply on the road. Because the same system spans strategy and field execution, the company gets continuity instead of a patchwork of one-off tools. That lets a small entertainment business behave more like a much larger operation without adding equivalent headcount.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Supports planning, marketing, scheduling, troubleshooting, and day-of-show execution across the business.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT voice mode
solution_components.role: Acts as a hands-free assistant during show days when the team is moving between operational tasks.

data_flow: Show logistics, marketing needs, sponsorship questions, equipment issues, and scheduling details are sent into ChatGPT, which returns scripts, plans, troubleshooting advice, and reminders that the founders use directly while managing tours and events.
business_outcome: ATV Big Air Tour reduced manual business overhead, moved work that once took weeks into a morning, and created more time for growth initiatives and family life.
